purpose: Expected artifact contract for the electrically complete V2 I2C power-conditioner example.

observed_board_export.hash_scope: The complete exported .kicad_pcb file from the recorded real run.
observed_board_export.non_repeatability: The engine currently assigns fresh UUIDs to generated mounting-hole footprints on each export. The source SHA and the verified circuit/DRC counts are stable, but a new export has a different whole-file SHA-256. Therefore e2e validates source and diagnostics, not this observed whole-file hash.

verification_contract.KiCad DRC: 0 errors; the 23 known generated-environment/presentation warnings are retained and enumerated by the diagnostics fixture

limitations: This is an evaluation-only reference, not a fabrication-approved board.
The real-run board SHA is evidence for its recorded export only because mounting-hole UUIDs are regenerated.
The direct toolchain check does not materialize or synchronize a native PhiCad revision.
